tests.label: Board meets in Jersey
tests.quote: the company’s board of directors meets in Jersey at an adequate frequency having regard to the amount of decision-making required at that level;

tests.label: Quorum of directors physically present in Jersey
tests.quote: at such board meetings described in sub-paragraph (a), there is a quorum of directors physically present in Jersey;

tests.label: Minutes record strategic decisions made at meeting
tests.quote: the minutes of such board meetings described in sub-paragraph (a) record the making of strategic decisions of the company at the meeting;

tests.label: Minutes and company records kept in Jersey
tests.quote: the minutes of all board meetings and the records of the company are kept in Jersey.

not_supported.requirement: adequate frequency having regard to amount of decision-making required
not_supported.quote: the company’s board of directors meets in Jersey at an adequate frequency having regard to the amount of decision-making required at that level;

not_supported.requirement: directors have necessary knowledge and expertise to discharge duties of board
not_supported.quote: the directors of the company have the necessary knowledge and expertise to discharge the duties of the board;

not_supported.requirement: adequate number of employees physically present in Jersey
not_supported.quote: there are an adequate number of employees in relation to that activity who are physically present in Jersey (whether or not employed by the resident company or by another entity and whether on temporary or long-term contracts),
there is adequate expenditure incurred in Jersey,
there are adequate physical assets in Jersey;

not_supported.requirement: all core income-generating activities carried out in Jersey
not_supported.quote: all of the company’s core income-generating activities are carried out in Jersey;

not_supported.requirement: ability to monitor and control outsourced core income-generating activities
not_supported.quote: if any core income-generating activities are carried out in Jersey for the company by another entity, the company is able to monitor and control the carrying out of that activity by the other entity.
